description: This file contains a Go implementation of a vSphere CSI Translator for Kubernetes, handling translation between in-tree vSphere volume specifications and CSI volume specifications, including support for topology translation and storage class parameter conversion.

classes.name: vSphereCSITranslator
classes.description: A struct implementing translation functions between in-tree vSphere volume specifications and CSI specifications.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Converts in-tree vSphere StorageClass parameters to CSI StorageClass parameters, including topology translation.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree vSphere volume to a CSI PersistentVolume object.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree vSphere PersistentVolume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree vSphere volume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given PersistentVolume.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given inline volume.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree vSphere plugin.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI vSphere plugin.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Returns the volume handle, used for volume attachment verification.
